card.name: Words just before dialysis or transfusion
card.fires_on: Small words and hyphen pieces right before dialysis or transfusion terms, or before a hemoglobin number, in anemia and kidney drug labels. Examples are "need for" before RBC transfusions, "not on" before dialysis, and "long-term" before dialysis.

modes.label: Before transfusion
modes.description: The word "for" after "reduce the need" in lowest-dose statements about red cell transfusions.
modes.example: Use the lowest dose of VAFSEO sufficient to reduce the need<< for>> red blood cell transfusions.

modes.label: Before dialysis
modes.description: "on" after "not" or "-term" after "long" just ahead of the word dialysis.

modes.label: Before hemoglobin value
modes.description: The space after "greater than" just before a hemoglobin number.
modes.example: a hemoglobin level of greater than<< >>11 g/dL increases the risk
